items.title: 33.2 Sources of Water Pollution (pani ki pollution ke sources) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.2 (PDF 249-250); the point and non-point drawings are our own (Figure 33.1 is a photograph).

blocks.text: Pollution ka source (zariya) chhota aur sirf ek jagah (single point) par ho sakta hai, ya bohat si jagahein ho sakti hain jo ek jaisi ya mukhtalif pollution daalti hain. Isi base (bunyaad) par pani ki pollution ke sources do qismon mein baante jate hain.
